summary: θ(f) is the case c = z = 0. For T_c f compare the coefficients at α: two polynomials agree if they agree at every point v, and evaluating at v the homogeneous part of total degree |α| is reading the coefficient of u^{|α|} of the one-variable restriction z = v·u; along a line both sides are Taylor series of the same function by `taylor_line_eq_subst_jetSeries` and the product formula.

steps.claim: θ(f) = Θ_f(0) = ∏_i G_i(0), from the hypothesis at c = 0, z = 0.
For every c: T_c f = ∏_i taylor(G_i) ∘ (μ_{c,i}·z).
steps.lean:
fun c ↦ by
  ext α
  have H {v S} (f := fun _ ↦ ()) : (truncFinset ℂ _ S).eval v = (rename f (rescale v S)).coeff
    (α.mapDomain f)
  simp [truncFinset, coeff_rename, MvPolynomial.eval_monomial]; ac_rfl
  rw [← coeff_truncFinset_of_mem, MvPolynomial.funext fun v ↦ (H.trans ?_).trans H.symm,
    coeff_truncFinset_of_mem] <;> simp
  have := (taylor_line_eq_subst_jetSeries hf c v).symm
  simp_all [← coe_substAlgHom, PowerSeries.subst, substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom_apply, mul_comm _
    (_ ⬝ᵥ v), linearSeries, -substAlgHom_apply, substAlgHom_X, rename_eq_subst, rescale_eq_subst]
  congr; induction @univ I _ using cons_induction <;> simp (disch := fun_prop) [*, ↓prod_cons,
    smul_smul, ← sum_smul, PowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst]
  tauto⟩

steps.claim: It suffices to compare the coefficients at every multi-index α.

Auxiliary identity H: for a vector v and a power series S, evaluating at v the homogeneous part of S of total degree |α| (its truncation to the monomials β with |β| = |α|, a finite set containing α) equals the coefficient of u^{|α|} of S rescaled by v and with all variables renamed to one variable u, i.e. [u^{|α|}]S(v·u). (A truncation to another finite set containing α could contain terms of other degrees, for which this fails.)
steps.lean:
have H {v S} (f := fun _ ↦ ()) : (truncFinset ℂ _ S).eval v = (rename f (rescale v S)).coeff
    (α.mapDomain f)
  simp [truncFinset, coeff_rename, MvPolynomial.eval_monomial]; ac_rfl
steps.typed_fact:
(truncFinset ℂ _ S).eval v = (rename f (rescale v S)).coeff
    (α.mapDomain f)

steps.claim: Proof of H: unfold the truncation, the renaming and the evaluation of monomials; the two sums agree term by term up to reordering of products.

Pass to the homogeneous parts of degree |α|: the coefficient at α of either side is that of this truncation (α lies in it), and two polynomials over ℂ are equal if their values at every v agree; by H it suffices to show that for every v the one-variable series S(v·u) agree for S = T_c f and S = ∏ subst.
steps.lean:
rw [← coeff_truncFinset_of_mem, MvPolynomial.funext fun v ↦ (H.trans ?_).trans H.symm,
    coeff_truncFinset_of_mem] <;> simp

steps.claim: Along v, T_c f restricted to z = v·u is the Taylor series of u ↦ Θ_f(u·c·v).
Rewrite both restrictions as substitutions into one-variable series; by the hypothesis Θ_f(u·c·v) = ∏_i G_i(u·(μ_{c,i}·v)).
steps.lean:
simp_all [← coe_substAlgHom, PowerSeries.subst, substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom_apply, mul_comm _
    (_ ⬝ᵥ v), linearSeries, -substAlgHom_apply, substAlgHom_X, rename_eq_subst, rescale_eq_subst]

steps.claim: By induction over the finite set I (adding one factor at a time), the Taylor series of u ↦ ∏_i G_i(u·(μ_{c,i}·v)) is the product of the series of G_i rescaled by μ_{c,i}·v (product rule for Taylor series of entire functions).
steps.lean:
congr; induction @univ I _ using cons_induction <;> simp (disch := fun_prop) [*, ↓prod_cons,
    smul_smul, ← sum_smul, PowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst]

steps.claim: The remaining propositional goal is closed.
